SASBDB entry SASDQE9  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDQE9/)

Publication: Structural basis of DNA binding by YdaT, a functional equivalent of the CII
             repressor in the cryptic prophage CP-933P from Escherichia coli O157:H7.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1107/S2059798323001249

The files are the SASBDB downloads, unchanged:
  experimental_data/SASDQE9.dat   the curve (q in nm^-1)
  SASDQE9_fit1.saxs               the AXES fit (q in 1/A; columns q, Iexp, Ierr, Icalc)
  SASDQE9_fit1_model1..10.pdb     the ten Xplor-NIH models of "fit1"; each file holds two MODEL records

The publisher's PDF is not kept here; fetch it from the DOI above. The fitting script
test/fitting_tests/SASDQE9/ cites what it takes from the SASBDB entry.
